title: Millennials in the Workplace
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
This is another great talk by Simon Sinek. It explains why we should leave our mobile devices at home when we go out, out of conference rooms, out of meetings altogether. When we do this, we focus on the people around us, and, as he explains, it's the small things in life that matter. The millennials are missing out on life, because cell phones and social media have taken over their lives.

We always ask people to turn off their cell phones and close laptops during our client engagements and training seminars. Warning: we may be asking you to leave them behind in the office altogether from now on...
